response.text:
Your appointment at the Ausländerbehörde is on **Wed 14 Oct 2026 at 10:30** [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp], for the residence permit (Aufenthaltserlaubnis) extension, at Stadt Musterstadt, Ausländerbehörde, Musterplatz 1, 2. OG, Raum 2.14 [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp].

Bring with you (per the to-do):
- Original passport
- Current enrolment certificate for winter semester 2026/27
- Proof of financial means
- Proof of health insurance
- A biometric photo
- Rental agreement or landlord confirmation
- The fee, payable by girocard only (cash not accepted) [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp]

This comes from the invitation letter from Stadt Musterstadt dated 16 Sep 2026 [doc:doc_d9hwr1mp3bsj].
